review.official:
Chiave, former employee of a mechanic shop in a small city in
Siracusa
, later became the leader of his own gang.
After a certain incident, he led two of his men to join
Rhodes Island
and is now active as a front-line attacker.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of his internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in his circulatory system, confirming him to be infected with Oripathy. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5%
Originium crystals are present on the surface of the body, but in small quantities. The disease progression has been effectively controlled. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
Although condition is currently relatively stable, it may deteriorate due to late treatment.

This Vulpo is a man who always carries around a hearty smile. 
'No respect for people or the law.' It is said that these words were used to describe his attitude when he first joined Rhodes Island and met Dr. Kal'tsit. He spent the rest of his first day in the infirmary. 
He will do whatever pops up in his mind. Although what he does is often laughable, there seems to be some magic within him that compels others to join him on his absurd antics.

Compared with Broca's hostility and Aosta's caution, Chiave, as their leader, was basically the first one to get integrated into Rhodes Island. On his second day, he basically already was accustomed to the general mood around the ship. 
According to his own account, he dropped out of school and worked as the employee of a mechanic shop in the city, of course privately participating in some local gang activities. 
That is, until he met Aosta. The two struck up a congenial relationship and worked together, later rescuing Broca and recruiting him to join. The three moved together until they were rescued by a nearby Rhodes Island during a chase.

As a result of his experience working as a mechanic, Chiave is the best at modifying weapons among the three. 
Unlike the impression his appearances give to other people, he is quite accomplished within his profession. Whether working directly on modern vehicles or souping them up, he maintains an impressive skillset. As an extension of his interests, he also has some knowledge in electrical appliances. 
However, unlike Broca, though Chiave is generally well-liked among other operators, he is often described as 'having a bad rap.' 
Because of his tendencies to push the boundaries in all aspects of life and work, he often adds truly head-scratching modifications to the things he's working on. Even when working on other peoples' things, he shows little regard for that and has caused some truly ridiculous outcomes. Now, everyone is a bit more cautious about handing their personal belongings over to him for retrofitting.

Aosta's terse evaluation of Chiave probably sums it up best — 'He's not gonna live long like this.' 
It must be pointed out that Chiave is not an extraordinarily strong man: he doesn't possess profound strategic wisdom, nor does he have exceptional combat prowess. He is very ordinary in many respects, and the sum of his combat effectiveness can be regarded as average at best. He is prone to flights of fancy, and often does things half-heartedly. To be frank, it would not be surprising if he was found dead in a ditch on the side of the road one day. 
However, this is what's astounding about him. 
Let's do something a bit dramatic to illustrate the point— Everyone in the room will say 'Chiave? Oh, that arrogant guy.' But without fail, most people will smile and add another sentence — 'But that's just the kind of person he is.' And some of these people will not hesitate to help him when they learn that he is in trouble. This is a good indicator of Chiave's popularity. He always leaves a deep impression upon others that makes it impossible to truly hate him. 
Of course, speaking from another angle, if he really was to suddenly leave us prematurely, most people would probably get over it pretty quickly, because 'that's just the kind of person he is.' 
That is the contradictory and fascinating person that Chiave is.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Ehi, Doctor, got anything fun to do?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Tsk, goddamn peppers... I gotta find a way to make them disappear from the canteen forever.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I heard Yanese got some old sayings similar to 'Catch the moment'. Heh, the line I like. Don't you think it suits me very well? The future? Meh, I'll let Aosta chew on those sorts of things.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Oi, Doctor, don't just sit there all day. Why don't we have some fun, like… remodeling your whole office?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Aosta once said I wouldn't live long like this. At the time, I told him, what's the point of long life if I can't do what I want?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Fight for what you want, snatch what you like. I don't know the meaning of the word 'Surrender'!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I think up what to do, Aosta thinks up how to do it, and Broca makes sure we get it done together. That's how we've always gotten by, and it's how we ended up here.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, what are you doing all frowny-faced over there? If there's anything weighing on you, just lay it on me. I'm good at that sort of stuff.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Say, Doctor, if someday you decide to quit running Rhodes Island, why not come along with us? Chiave doesn't take orders from anyone, but in your case, I'll make an exception.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Ehi, Doctor... You fell asleep? Whatever, I'll be back later.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Yo, are you the Doctor? Hello, and well met. The name's Chiave. Starting today, I'm your goon!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Whoa-ho-ho... Hey Aosta, check this out! Give me a moment and I'll be even stronger than these guys!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Huh? Promotion? What do you mean?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Incredible. There are just too many interesting people here at Rhodes Island. How am I supposed to just stay in my seat? I've gotta get stronger and stronger!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ha, here we go!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Listen up, everyone, I have a plan!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Haha, let's go make some noise!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Just gotta knock 'em all down, right?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Still not my turn yet?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: C'mon, don't make me yawn.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I can't wait any longer!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Haha, I'm gonna end you all!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Take this!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hey! Why are you running?!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, you've all done a great JOB!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'm on FIRE!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Hah, now this is the fun stuff!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Ah. Where's the challenge in that, Doctor?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Huh? I left a few? Never even saw 'em.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Shit, for real?!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: ello, bruthas and sistahs!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What is it?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yo, Doctor, you're in a pretty good mood.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor! Aosta, Broca, and I have a new New Year's plan. Heh heh, once I tell you, you're in on the game. We're going to swap out all the chocolate sauce in the canteen for Siracusan meat sauce, then— Huh? Doctor, where are you going?! Don't you tell Dr. Kal'tsit!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ehi Doc, did you have a good meal?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Ehi, Doctor, Happy birthday! Ta-dah— Check out this model car. I made it myself. It's yours now. Truth be told, if the conditions were right, I would've built you an actual car. Well, I guess that's a promise. Doctor, come visit me in Siracusa sometime and I'll trade this for a real car.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island's got all these heavies, plus smart people like you. One day, someday, I'm gonna do something big that'll rock the whole world! At the very least, I'll do it before I die! Uh, I should try to stay alive...? I guess you're right, haha…
